text:
Ravi Menon: Quick sync — Acme's renewal is targeted for next Tue. Procurement emailed asking for an updated quote reflecting the seat +10% increase and confirmation of who will sign.
Maya Chen: Got it. Are they asking for e-sign or a scanned wet signature? Any PO requirements?
Ravi Menon: They prefer DocuSign. PO would be nice but not blocking; payment term ask is net60 -> they want net45. Also asked about prorating first invoice for mid-cycle add-on.
Jason Patel: I talked to the CFO earlier — he prefers e-sign and wants the invoice schedule clarified. On pricing: they asked if we can keep current unit pricing but apply a one-time credit instead of a permanent discount. I told them I’d check.
Maya Chen: Understood. Legal involvement for the payment term change?
Claire Nguyen: Quick note — net45 is usually OK but we need to update the amendment language for Section 2.2 and the signature block. Also confirm there’s no new warranty or data clause changes. Send the proposed amendment and SOW; I’ll review.
Ravi Menon: Sending draft now. Also we need signer availability windows — they prefer mornings PST. Who's the signatory name exactly?
Jason Patel: CFO will sign, name is Ben Russo. He’s available Tue/Wed 10–11am PST.
Maya Chen: @Claire can you aim for redlines by EOD Monday so we can hit Tue morning slot? If you need more time, flag it.
Claire Nguyen: I’ll get to it by EOD Monday; if I need more time I’ll flag Monday morning.
StripeBot: Invoice webhook failure detected for invoice_12345 — delivery retries scheduled (FYI).
Ravi Menon: Noted on the webhook, not blocking the signing.
Maya Chen: Procurement also asked whether we can mirror their existing PO number on our invoice for continuity. Can finance accept that?
Jason Patel: Finance confirmed we can map their PO number to our invoice. No problem.
Maya Chen: For the DocuSign envelope, do we include the full SOW or just the amendment?
Claire Nguyen: Include both amendment and SOW. Add signer role "Authorized Signatory" and make sure the amendment references the original contract ID.
Ravi Menon: Provisional signing slot: Tue 10:30am PST. @Jason can you lock Ben for that time?
Jason Patel: Asking Ben now, will confirm in thread.
Maya Chen: I’ll prepare the DocuSign envelope template and pre-fill recipient. Will wait for Claire’s redlines.
Ravi Menon: Minor risk: if Legal can’t finish redlines until Tue morning we may miss Ben’s window. Contingency: offer Wed 10:30am PST as second slot.
Jason Patel: Noted, I'm asking Ben to tentatively hold both Tue/Wed 10:30am PST.
Maya Chen: Thanks team :thumbsup: I’ll update the calendar and send the envelope once redlines are in.
Claire Nguyen: If you want, include a short cover email in the envelope explaining the net45 change and the one-time credit approach — helps procurement.
Ravi Menon: Good idea. I’ll draft cover note and share.
Jason Patel: Confirmed Ben will hold Tue 10:30am PST and prefers DocuSign. I’ll post here if anything changes.
Maya Chen: Perfect. That’s all for now — will follow up after Claire’s redlines. :white_check_mark:
